Chapter 6909: Darkness Destroying The Primordial

Chapter 6909: Darkness Destroying The Primordial

Dark Judgment reigned supreme for epochs even against more powerful immortals. Today, a mortal put an end to its streak without lifting a hand.

Guangmai himself couldn’t fathom the failure since he had great confidence in Dark Judgment. He thought it would be enough to catch a glimpse of the mortal’s control over the heart.

He allowed his underlings to attack first, hoping to see enough to duplicate the control.

“Who are you?” He asked again.

“A passerby.” Li Qiye had the same answer.

“Then why are you here in Stygian?” He asked.

“To wipe out your alliance and the darkness since you are all here.” Li Qiye smiled.

Earlier, they heard the same thing but didn’t take him seriously. Now, their confidence wavered after he took one hit after another, unscathed.

“Anything else? After all, you will be turned into fertilizer soon.” Li Qiye asked.

The group exchanged glances of hesitation.

“Then I will start?” Li Qiye smiled and stepped forward, causing them to retreat instinctively.

They turned red from humiliation, having never shown this much anxiety in the past. Others feared them, not the other way around.

“Only cowards who have lost the heroism to fight, preferring to live borrowed lives.” Li Qiye remarked.

“We have roamed untethered across Heavenrealm, we’re not afraid of you!” Fire Immortal shouted.

“Then come first to meet death.” Li Qiye waved provocatively.

“You!” Fire Immortal had an ugly expression but his feet remained planted. His tribulation flame had zero effect, shattering his confidence.

“You can’t imagine our true potential, we haven’t used our ace card yet.” Guangmai said.

“Oh? Then what is your ace card? Perhaps I should start with you, primordial immortal.” Li Qiye gestured again as if he were beckoning a dog.

“No rush, I will let you see our alliance’s might first.” Guangmai only took one second to regain his composure.

“Boom!” He held the staff and ordered everyone: “Brothers, the day of revitalization is upon us, we shall be as one.”

“Rumble!” The staff released a power that glimmered in the dark.

“Start the grand momentum!” The immortals understood what to do upon seeing the spread of immortal dao and primordial aura.

The twenty grand immortals and five golden immortals assumed their chosen coordinates.

“Go!” Guangmai’s staff lit up brightly, capable of blinding any combatant.

“Rumble!” The dark ocean surged and spread toward the twenty-five immortals.

“Grand momentum!” Their dark power erupted, combined, and took the form of black wings.

“Darkness Destroying the Primordial!” The grand momentum and all else condensed into the purest dark beam to shoot Li Qiye.

Anyone who had seen this before didn’t live to tell the tales.
